title: DonutSMP Duel Songs
description: Adds New Songs That Play After You Win a Duel/Enter the Queue for One on DonutSMP
body:
# 🎶**After Duel/In Queue Duel Songs on DonutSMP**🎵 # UNFORTUNATLY IN THE NEW UPDATE DUELS WERE REMOVED FROM DONUT SMP SO THiS PACK IS POINTLESS AND I WASTED MY TIME MAKING IT BAD NEW UPDATE L OWNER DR COCONUT ## **What this Resource Pack Does** - Replaces the music disc tracks that DonutSMP plays into custom music packs - After Duel CUSTOM Music - Queue into duel CUSTOM music ## **Demo** **DEMO VIDEO DEMONSTRATING ->** [Watch The Demo Video [Click Me]](https://jumpshare.com/share/wANI0q9fHTn9M8eyPUDm) _Made by Czepheran_
How to Use It To duel into DonutSMP.net type the command [/warp duels]. Once you enter a duel, you will be put in a queue. This is where you will first hear custom music. Then, once your duel has started, the queueing music will stop. Lock in and beat the player you are fighting! If you win, Win Celebration custom music will start playing.
How Do I Load the Pack Into Minecraft? _To Load the pack into Minecraft, you must click the Windows Key + R. After type in %appdata% Click the .minecraft folder and scroll down until you see "ResourcePacks". Click into that folder. Put this pack "DonutSMP Duel Songs" in there. Load Minecraft for the version you downloaded the resource pack for. Next, join a server/world. Press esc. Then go into options. Click resource packs. Select "DonutSMP Duel Songs.zip"._ **Here is a video to help you:**
Why Can't I Hear Anything? You can't hear anything probably because of one of these reasons: 1. You don't have your Jukebox/Noteblock sounds turned up in your Minecraft settings 2. You need to enable After Duel Songs in /settings on DonutSMP to on (It's the noteblock icon)
